scheme_name: Coaching by Private Institutes for All India Services Civil Services Examination
other_conditions: Must have been selected based on merit in Arts, Commerce, Science, Engineering or Medical groups
Must not have availed the benefits of this scheme before
Must register a profile on the MPTAASC portal
Age will be determined by UPSC as per the Civil Services (Pre) exam eligibility criteria
Priority given if the applicant has passed the Civil Services Main Examination of Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission in the last three years
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2 lakhs for coaching fees, a one‑time ₹15 000 book allowance, and a monthly stipend of ₹12 500 (including transport, housing and food) for up to 18 months.
